Download a single climate index

Source: R/download.R
get_index.Rd

Downloads and parses a climate oscillation index from its source URL. Supports monthly, daily, and bimonthly indices from NOAA PSL and CPC.

Usage

get_index(name, refresh = FALSE, timeout = 30, quiet = FALSE)

Arguments

name

Character. Index name (e.g., "NAO", "Nino34", "PDO"). Use list_indices() to see all available indices.

refresh

Logical. If TRUE, forces download even if cached data exists. Currently not implemented (reserved for future caching).

timeout

Numeric. Request timeout in seconds. Default is 30.

quiet

Logical. If TRUE, suppresses progress messages.

Value

A tibble containing the index data. Columns vary by resolution:

Monthly

date, year, month, value, index, description, category, source_url

Daily

date, year, month, day, value, index, description, category, source_url

Bimonthly

date, year, month, bimonth, value, index, description, category, source_url

Returns NULL if download fails.

Details

This function downloads data directly from authoritative sources:

  • Monthly indices: NOAA Physical Sciences Laboratory (PSL)

  • Daily indices: NOAA Climate Prediction Center (CPC) FTP

  • MEI v2: NOAA PSL ENSO page

Missing values in source data (typically encoded as -99.9, -999, etc.) are automatically converted to NA.

References

Trenberth, K. E. (1997). The definition of El Nino. Bulletin of the American Meteorological Society, 78(12), 2771-2778. doi:10.1175/1520-0477(1997)078<2771:TDOENO>2.0.CO;2

Mantua, N. J., Hare, S. R., Zhang, Y., Wallace, J. M., & Francis, R. C. (1997). A Pacific interdecadal climate oscillation with impacts on salmon production. Bulletin of the American Meteorological Society, 78(6), 1069-1079. doi:10.1175/1520-0477(1997)078<1069:APICOW>2.0.CO;2

Enfield, D. B., Mestas-Nunez, A. M., & Trimble, P. J. (2001). The Atlantic multidecadal oscillation and its relation to rainfall and river flows in the continental U.S. Geophysical Research Letters, 28(10), 2077-2080. doi:10.1029/2000GL012745

Hurrell, J. W. (1995). Decadal trends in the North Atlantic Oscillation: regional temperatures and precipitation. Science, 269(5224), 676-679. doi:10.1126/science.269.5224.676

Thompson, D. W. J., & Wallace, J. M. (2000). Annular modes in the extratropical circulation. Part I: month-to-month variability. Journal of Climate, 13(5), 1000-1016. doi:10.1175/1520-0442(2000)013<1000:AMITEC>2.0.CO;2

Barnston, A. G., & Livezey, R. E. (1987). Classification, seasonality and persistence of low-frequency atmospheric circulation patterns. Monthly Weather Review, 115(6), 1083-1126. doi:10.1175/1520-0493(1987)115<1083:CSAPOL>2.0.CO;2

Examples

if (FALSE) { # \dontrun{
# Download the North Atlantic Oscillation
nao <- get_index("NAO")

# Download Nino 3.4 SST anomalies
nino34 <- get_index("Nino34")

# Download daily Arctic Oscillation
ao_daily <- get_index("AO_daily")
} # }
